m5l1_en_en:
Where does the yield come from, and how do
you get your money back?
Let's see.

Here's how your money works, in three
steps.
One: you deposit.

Relay moves the money to Robinhood Chain
and converts it into USDG, and you only
sign on your own network.
Two: the vault earns.

The operator puts the USDG into the
stock's Uniswap pool, within a price

range, and collects the fees every twelve
hours.

The fees stay in the vault and raise the
value of your share.
Three: you withdraw.
You sign the request, with no gas.

The operator unwinds your part, converts
it to USDG and sends it to the network and
asset you choose.

Sometimes a stock jumps, for example at
earnings or when the market opens.
Then the vault pauses itself, for safety.

Your money stays in the vault and keeps
earning, but deposits and USDG withdrawals
wait.

If you need to leave sooner, the in-kind
exit stays available: you receive the
stock plus USDG.

And remember: the yield comes from swap
fees.
It varies every day and is not guaranteed.
m5l1_en_pt:
De onde vem o rendimento, e como você
recebe seu dinheiro de volta?
Vamos ver.

Veja como o seu dinheiro funciona, em três
passos.
Um: você deposita.

A Relay leva o dinheiro para a Robinhood
Chain e converte em USDG, e você só assina
na sua própria rede.
Dois: o vault rende.

O operador coloca o USDG na pool da
Uniswap daquela ação, dentro de uma faixa

de preço, e recolhe as taxas a cada doze
horas.

As taxas ficam no vault e aumentam o valor
da sua cota.
Três: você saca.
Você assina o pedido, sem gas.

O operador desfaz a sua parte, converte em
USDG e envia para a rede e a moeda que
você escolher.

Às vezes uma ação dá um salto, por exemplo
na divulgação de resultados ou na abertura
do mercado.

Aí o vault se pausa sozinho, por
segurança.

Seu dinheiro fica no vault e continua
rendendo, mas depósitos e saques em USDG
esperam.

Se você precisar sair antes, a saída em
espécie continua disponível: você recebe a
ação mais USDG.

E lembre: o rendimento vem das taxas de
swap.
Ele varia todos os dias e não é garantido.

RobinVault publishes the risks of every
piece behind your deposit, in plain
language.
Let's go through the main ones.

Robinhood stock tokens: each token tracks
the price of a US stock, but it is a debt

security of the issuer, not the stock
itself.

Robinhood Chain: like anywhere in DeFi,
there is a risk of technical failure or of
a price depeg.

Uniswap: the code is among the most
battle-tested in DeFi.

The bigger risk is economic: impermanent
loss and the price range.

If the price moves a lot, you can end up
with less than if you had simply held the
stock.
Relay moves your money between networks.

USDG, the vaults' digital dollar, is
issued by a regulated company and backed
by reserves, and is rated low risk.
And one golden rule.

RobinVault never asks you to sign Permit,
Permit2, eth_sign or setApprovalForAll,
nor for your seed phrase.

If your wallet shows a request like that,
reject it.

Let's go through the checklist before your
first deposit.

Before starting: you're 18 or older and in
an eligible country, you've read the terms

and the risk reports, and you only invest
what you can afford to lose.

Your wallet: installed from the official
source, seed phrase on paper and offline,

and a little gas on the network you'll
use.

Your first deposit: check that you're on
robinvault dot io, start small, test a

deposit and a withdrawal, and read the
Review before signing.

And never: share your seed phrase, sign
Permit, Permit2, eth_sign or

setApprovalForAll, or treat the APR as a
promise.

That's it! You can come back to any lesson
whenever you want.
Thanks for watching, and good luck.
